parlays.title: Parlay all-in seguro
parlays.rationale: The parlay consists of six highly promotable legs with strong underlying probabilities and conservative odds, all within the preferred odds range of 1.01-1.20. Each selected leg is either a double chance or a head-to-head favorite, or a low goals_over_under line (Over 1.5), demonstrating inherent safety. Predictions were chosen to ensure at most one leg per fixture. Predictions with lower confidence or 'review-required' status were omitted to maintain overall parlay strength and avoid fragility, especially those with warnings indicating distorted probabilities or uncalibrated confidence.
